**New Features / Improvements:**

* Added general cooldown for file and url opening actions.
* Added branded HTML proxy error pages.
* Added shared application metadata singleton.
* Added tray shortcut to system proxy settings.
* Updated about dialog license placement to center alignment within textbox.
* Updated to centralized proxy configuration.
* Updated look of checkbox menu items to be more obvious.
* Improved logger initialization and null safety.
* Improved atomic saving of tray settings.
* Improved tray menu event handler complexity.

**Bug Fixes:**

* Fixed premature HTTPS tunnel disconnections.

**Known Issues / Limitations:**

* The Console app does not support saving proxy state across restarts, automatically starting at system login, logging to a file, nor checking for preview release updates. For these features, use the Tray app, which is better suited for these things.
* Although improved in this release, still some apps like Teams continue to disconnect when the proxy is set at the system level. As a workaround, set it at the app level like within a browser's configuration. A permanent fix is being investigated.
